intended_use: Experimental approximation of OSRM road-time estimates for pickup points in this region when OSRM data is unavailable. Not a real journey-time predictor: no observed journeys exist.

training_data.source: OSRM public demo server (router.project-osrm.org), table service, driving profile
training_data.target: OSRM estimated driving duration (not an observed journey time)

evaluation.method: 5-fold cross-validation grouped by school (seed 42); held-out schools appear in no training pair

candidates.M1: Calibrated speed: ridge on straight-line miles

limitations: Target is OSRM's estimate, not observed travel: no traffic, time of day, weather or dwell time.
Trained on 60 pickup points in South Wales and one destination; outside this region it is untested.
Grouped CV estimates error for new points in the same region only.
